title: LegalChoiceSet
description: The set a policy chooses from (ADR-006), for one request. Its request_seq, request_hash and rqid are RequestIdentity's fields.

request_seq.description: Areneon's 1-based count of the requests one player has received in this battle, including wait requests.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical request JSON without rqid (ADR-004 r2): lowercase hex.

rqid.description: The Showdown server's request id; present only on the server path (A2, the advisor), never hashed.

showdown_commit.description: The pinned engine commit that enumerated and judged the set.

choices.description: Not pending; engine-accepted wherever a ChoiceJudge exists. Canonical order (ADR-006).

pending.description: Offered without a verdict: their legality depends on hidden information. The engine decides when one is submitted.
